description: This file defines a React context for managing notes in a mobile app, including state management, persistence via AsyncStorage, and utility functions for CRUD operations.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional initial data, assigns a UUID, and adds it to the notes list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with a given patch of fields.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note with a specified id from the notes list.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Simulates synchronization process; currently a placeholder with delay.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom hook providing access to notes state, CRUD methods, search query, and sync status.
